summary: Iter79 (Joint Records Ingestion in Complete Report PDF + Share Complete passphrase modal + Assessments empty-state nudge). Backend: 5/5 new pytest scenarios green in test_iter79_joint_summary.py — (1) unauth POST /api/portal/complete-report-pdf renders 'Joint Alignment Summary' heading + 'No joint alignment on file yet' stub, no 'Shared Goals' sub-heading; (2) authed parent1@test.com with zero agreements docs falls back to the same empty stub; (3) authed with a seeded agreements doc renders all six sub-headings (Shared Goals / Communication / Child Needs / Household Rules / Priority Items / Open for Discussion) plus bullet items, overview prose, and the italic closing_note; (4) malformed agreements doc (weird_key, ints, None, bare strings, wrong types on shared_goals/communication) does not 500 — 200 PDF; (5) share mint with artefact_type='complete' + passphrase='demo42' + ttl_days=7 returns requires_passphrase:true / ttl_days:7, ?p omitted → HTML gate, ?p=demo42 → 200 application/pdf. Also re-ran iter78 suite (8/8 green) as regression. PDF text extraction uses zlib.decompress on every stream + '(text) Tj' regex per fpdf 1.3 output. Frontend @ 390x844: (A) assessments empty-state nudge — click toolkit-link-{medical|educational|psychological} opens Assessments section with assessment-empty-{...} card + 'You have 0 {kind} records yet' copy + green + Add-your-first-{kind}-record button (assessment-empty-add-{...}) that opens modal-alignment; 'Show all records' → assessment-empty-all visible; after seeding 1 Medical record, assessment-empty-medical disappears while educational/psychological empties still show when clicked. (B) share-complete modal — share-complete-report-btn opens modal-share-complete with title 'Share Complete Coparenting Report', all five expected testids present (share-complete-passphrase / share-complete-ttl-7 / share-complete-ttl-30 / mint-share-complete-btn / close-share-complete-modal); minting with passphrase='demo42' + ttl=7 populates share-complete-result within ~1s containing the /api/portal/share/{id}.pdf URL AND the passphrase 'demo42'; close-share-complete-modal dismisses cleanly. (C) Regressions — download-complete-report-btn triggers a real page.expect_download() with suggested_filename=sacoparents-complete-report.pdf (via focus+Enter to bypass the iter78 bottom-nav z-index overlap that main agent hasn't fixed yet); legal share flow with OLD testids still opens modal-share-legal (title 'Share Legal Report Link', all share-legal-* testids present) after entering court key ALIGN-SA-2026 → share-legal-btn; iter77 advocate-review-tile visible under flagged safety-ack in BIFF tab; iter75 biff-greyrock-chip visible under flagged safety-ack. Zero horizontal overflow at 390x844 across gateway, coparenting journey (empty + populated), court-key path, and both share modals (legal + complete).

critical_code_review_comments: portal_pdf.build_portal_complete_report_pdf now branches on has_joint_summary using `any(joint_summary.get(k) for k in joint_sections)` — this correctly falls through when the doc is present but all keys are None/empty (matches the malformed-doc test case).

portal_routes.get_current_user_optional recreates HTTPBearer inline per-request. Clean but allocates on every call; a module-level `_bearer = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)` would be cheaper. Not a correctness issue.

In the joint_summary render loop, priority_items/child_needs dicts fall through key names in order (agreement / statement / clause / text / topic / value); if a caller stores the item under an unrelated key it silently drops. Acceptable for iter79 (matches joint_agreement's write shape) but worth a comment.
SacoparentsPortal.jsx remains ~1567 lines — grew slightly with the share-complete state; consider extracting a usePortalShare hook.
ShareLegalModal accepts variant='complete' but the CTA button label is still 'Create link & copy' (not variant-driven) — cosmetic, matches the request.
